7.2.2 Timing Related Functionality
To be able to measure times, the J1939 Request Manager is triggered cyclically via the J1939Rm_MainFunction.
[SWS_J1939Rm_00072] ⌈The J1939 Request Manager shall use the J1939Rm_MainFunction for timing related purposes.⌋(SRS_BSW_00478)
